#!git
git config --global user.name "Ada Learner"
git config --global user.email "ada@example.org"
git config --global init.defaultBranch main
@ mkdir bakery-menu && cd bakery-menu && git init -q && printf "# Sunrise Bakery menu\n\n- White loaf: 2.80\n- Rolls (six): 3.00\n" > menu.md && printf %s  | base64 -d > ci.sh && git add . && git commit -q -m "Add the menu and a check script" && cd ..
cd bakery-menu
cat ci.sh
sh ci.sh
echo "exit code: $?"
ls dist
printf -- '- Coffee: two pounds\n' >> menu.md
sh ci.sh
echo "exit code: $?"
